problem: Solve the inequality ${x}^{2}\ge 5$ using the absolute value method.
worked_solution:
Taking the square root of both sides of the inequality, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{2} & \ge 5 \\ \sqrt{{x}^{2}} & \ge \sqrt{5} \\ |x| & \ge \sqrt{5}.\end{aligned}
$$

Now, using the definition of absolute value, we must have

$$
x\le -\sqrt{5}\,\text{or}\,x\ge \sqrt{5}.
$$

Therefore the solution is $x\in (-\infty ,-\sqrt{5}]\cup [\sqrt{5},\infty ).$
